slug: 2026-01-15 How Digital Public Infrastructure Is Transforming Health and Identity in Rural Zambia

facts.fact: The implementers (IHM Southern Africa, Co-Develop) describe SmartCare Pro as a centralised electronic health record that uses the National Digital ID service to create a unique patient record, with a nurse at a rural clinic in Kafulafuta identifying a patient by fingerprint to reach his record, said to be retrievable at any public hospital; no figures are given and the publication date is used.

The article states that the Government of Zambia launched SmartCare Pro in partnership with TuSo Business Dynamics, the technology division of IHM Southern Africa; it names no ministry unit and gives no launch date, so the publication date is used.

systems.platform: centralised EHR built by TuSo Business Dynamics (IHM Southern Africa)
systems.owner: Government of Zambia with IHM Southern Africa
systems.tiers: a rural clinic in Kafulafuta is described; records said to be reachable at any public hospital

note: Promotional first-hand account by the system's builders: one testimony, no coverage figures.
